mapper.select: select * from vpn.setting_character where ownerUserId is null or ownerUserId = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into vpn.setting_character(title, content, url, extra, ownerUserId, createdAt) values (#{title}, #{content}, #{url}, #{extra}, #{ownerUserId}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from vpn.setting_character where id = #{id} and ownerUserId = #{ownerUserId}
